verses.text: Ach in Diosal, ok'ok wal a k'ool t'ayin, a t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il. In gana tzin kol in b'a t'ayach icha tz'aj skolan sb'a nok' yunetak kaxlanh t'a yalanh sk'axil snun, masanto ol lajwokek' jun yaelal tik.
Ach in Diosal te niwan elk'ochi, tzin awaj t'ayach, yujto a achnhej tzach kolwajnhej wet'ok.
Ha yuj a wach'k'olal, yuj pax to tz'elk'och tas tzala', yuj chi' masanto t'a satcha'anh tzak'kot in kolnab'il. Ol in a kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzin ixtan chi'.
Ichato t'a skal nok' choj schi'an anima ayin eq'ui. Ha k'een ye heb' lajan icha k'een lanza yet' te' jul-lab'. Ha tas syal heb', lajan icha k'een espada te jay ye.
Ach in Diosal, tzek'b'at sniwanil elk'och t'a satcha'anh. Ha sniwanil elk'och chi', chekel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin, ix yak'em in yaalil heb', manhxo animaok waj yuj heb', ix sb'oan jun olan heb' t'a yol in b'e, palta hanheja' heb' ix b'at t'a yool.
Ach in Diosal, b'ekan in k'ool, in gana tzach in b'itej yet' wach' lolonel.
Yuj chi' ol wak'el in wayanh, ol ach in b'itej yet' te' arpa yet' salterio. Ayik wan sakb'i, ol el in wayanh, ol ach in b'itani.
Mamin, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh chonhab'. Ol ach in b'itej t'a skal juntzanh nakión.
Niwan ton a wach'k'olal, masanto t'a satcha'anh sk'ochi. Tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Ach in Diosal, tzek'b'at sniwanil elk'och t'a satcha'anh. Ha sniwanil elk'och chi', chekel t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
